note: every message that voices the need counts once; a '+1 same for us' counts; a question about who or when, greetings and chatter do not.

themes.title: Every number in an answer links to its source
Approval before an agent writes to a connected system

slack.text: Mia (Finance): Joule told me the open invoices total 184k. Where does that number come from? I cannot check it, so I cannot use it in the board deck.
Good morning everyone, coffee machine on 3 is fixed again.
Jonas (Sales): Same problem with the pipeline numbers. A link to the table or the ticket behind each figure would save me ten minutes per answer.
Kim (Operations): Heads up, yesterday the agent added a comment to a Jira ticket on its own. It was harmless, but nobody asked me first. We need an approval step before an agent writes anything.

replies.text: +1, in Legal we would only allow that if we see the exact text beforehand.
Which agent was it? Was that the one from the Renewals demo?

slack.text: Sophie (Management): Could Joule send me a short summary every morning in Slack? Open decisions, risks, what changed since yesterday. I do not want to open another app first.
Quellenangaben fehlen mir auch. Ich glaube einer Zahl nur, wenn ich sie in zwei Klicks prüfen kann. (Tobias, Controlling)
Eine tägliche Zusammenfassung per Slack am Morgen wäre für mein Team genau richtig. (Anja, Vertrieb)
Thanks for the quick fix on the dashboard, looks great now!
